styles.label: Beach
styles.blurb: Island beaches, wrecks and sunset swims.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: War sites, museums and old town lanes.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Seafood, cheap local eats and night markets.

stays.why: Walk to the ferry, markets, museums and cheap eats. Best base without a car.
Modern hotels and malls, a short walk from the town centre and waterfront.
Handy for early boats to Brunei and Sabah; simple guesthouses nearby.
Quieter beach side with resorts; you will want a car or taxi here.

food: Eat seafood by the waterfront: grilled fish and prawns, prices vary by catch, so ask before ordering.
Try local noodles and rice dishes at coffee shops in town; a simple meal is often around RM8–15.
Pasar (market) stalls are good for cheap breakfast and fruit in the morning.
Night markets and food courts are the budget option; bring small cash notes.
Alcohol is limited and pricey on the island; many places are halal and dry. Check on the day.
more_time: Take a boat trip to one of the nearby small islands for snorkelling; check sea conditions and prices locally.
Visit the war memorial and museum sites if you like history; allow a half day.
Hop a ferry to Menumbok or Brunei for a change of scene; check schedules and passport rules first.

recommend.why: One night covers the town, markets and a beach; add a night for island trips or war history.

month_notes: Jan: warm and very wet, about 24 rain days. Pack a rain jacket.
Feb: the driest month, around 18 rain days. Best odds of dry beach time.
Mar: wet again, about 21 rain days. Plan indoor backups.
Apr: hot and very wet, around 25 rain days.
May: wettest stretch, about 26 rain days. Short heavy showers likely.
Jun: still wet, around 23 rain days. Mornings often better.
Jul: about 21 rain days. Warm days around 30°C.
Aug: similar to July, around 21 rain days.
Sep: rain picks up, about 23 rain days.
Oct: very wet, around 27 rain days. Expect delays on boats.
Nov: very wet, around 27 rain days. Keep plans flexible.
Dec: very wet, around 27 rain days. Book refundable stays.

climate_guide.summary: Tropical and hot all year, with rain in every month. February is the driest; October to December the wettest.

items.title: Warm all year
items.text: Days sit around 29–30°C and nights around 25–26°C. No cool season.

items.title: Rain every month
items.text: Expect 18–27 rain days a month. Showers are often short but heavy.

items.title: Best odds: February
items.text: About 18 rain days, the lowest of the year. Still bring a rain jacket.

items.title: Wettest: October to December
items.text: Around 27 rain days each month. Sea trips may be cancelled.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light, quick-dry clothes, sandals, a rain jacket or umbrella, and sunscreen.

items.title: Ferry weather
items.text: Heavy rain and rough seas can delay boats. Check schedules on the day.

transit.best: Walk in town; agree taxi fares first; rent a scooter for the beaches.

modes.text: No metro or tram on the island.
Local vans run fixed routes for RM1–3 but stop by 7PM. Not for evenings.
Taxis have no meters, so agree the fare before boarding. Grab may work but coverage is patchy; check locally.
Scooters rent from about RM38 per 24 hours near the ferry terminal. Good for reaching beaches.
The town centre is small and walkable. Fine for markets, ferry and museums.
Ferries link the island to Brunei, Menumbok, Sipitang, Lawas and Limbang. Check schedules on the day.
